home.tagline_b: if I can, you can too.
home.about_body: illusd is a Vibe Coding article platform for people starting from zero. We document the process of learning to code, building products and writing articles so anyone — at any age — can follow along and ship their first work. Read articles, comment, subscribe to new-article notifications, or sign in to chat with the creators directly.

editor.title: Write Article
editor.format_hint: Use this format and we'll auto-split episode / title / topic.
editor.topic_hint: Pick an existing series or create a new one.
editor.help_markdown:
===== Headings =====
# H1 (use once per article)
## H2 for sections
### H3 for subsections

===== Inline =====
**bold**  __also bold__
*italic*  _also italic_
~~strikethrough~~
`inline code`

===== Blockquote =====
> Single-line quote
>
> Second paragraph
>> Nested quote

===== Lists =====
- Unordered item A
- Unordered item B
  - Child item

1. Ordered item one
2. Ordered item two
   1. Nested ordered item

- [ ] Todo
- [x] Done

===== Links & Images =====
This is a [link](https://illusd.com "hover title")
Autolink: <https://illusd.com>
Reference link: see [docs][doc]

[doc]: https://illusd.com/terms-of-service

Image:
![Alt text](https://example.com/cover.jpg)

Clickable image:
[![Alt text](https://example.com/thumb.jpg)](https://illusd.com)

===== Tables =====
| Field | Center | Right |
| :--- | :---: | ---: |
| A | C | 1 |
| B | C | 22 |

===== Code Blocks =====
```js
function greet(name) {
  console.log(`hello ${name}`);
}
```

```python
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
```

===== Horizontal Rule =====
---

===== Escape / Line Break =====
Show literal stars: \*not italic\*
Leave a blank line between paragraphs; add two spaces at line end for a line break.
